blurb: The Adventure Center rents high quality outdoor equipment for various adventure sports including cross country skis, snowshoes, backpacks, sleeping bags, and mountain bikes. It also hosts fitness events such as the DEKA FIT Roadshow and Powerlifting Competition. Facilities including meeting rooms and fields are available for rental by university departments.
extraNote: No online reservations for equipment rentals; call or visit in person · All equipment must be returned clean, dry, and in good working order by due time · Late fees apply at daily rental rate per item; cleaning fee $25; damage and replacement fees charged at retail price · Facility rentals require minimum 1 hour, 30 days advance booking, and $50 non-refundable admin fee · Cancellations for facility rentals must be made 72 hours in advance for refund minus admin fee · Cycle Share late return fee $5 per day; replacement fees charged for lost items · UConn Adventure Center located in the Student Recreation Center, Northeast corner of the building, across from the Graduate Center
